errors.evidence: The description incorrectly swaps the axes. The vertical (y) axis displays the categories (time periods), while the horizontal (x) axis displays the percentage values.
The value for the 2013-2018 period is clearly below 30%, at approximately 29%. The description incorrectly states it is 'a little over 30%'.
The value for the period 1996-2001 is approximately 18%. The stated value of 'around 19%' is an overestimation.
The value for the period 2008-2012 is approximately 21%. The stated value of 'around 22%' is an overestimation.
